title: Official Addons Cross-Repo Fearless Refactor
problem: The official metadata addon has reached a point where the next risks are protected-write client drift, broad provider adapters, and missing host-dispatched Addon Task path smoke coverage.
gates: focused ../nako addon-client/protocol gates when OACR-020 touches public client/protocol
official addon task-path smoke when OACR-050 is implemented

evidence.summary: Architecture review recorded three concrete issues: private protected-write client duplication, broad Bangumi/Douban provider adapters, and missing official Addon Task path smoke.
Bangumi provider split into facade plus client/enrichment/search/parser/mapper/test_support modules; focused nextest, fmt, and path-scoped diff gates passed.
Douban provider split into facade plus client/enrichment/parser/mapper/test_support modules; focused nextest, fmt, and path-scoped diff gates passed.

Protected-write runtime DTOs and client helpers moved into public Nako addon protocol/client crates; metadata scraper runtime facade now delegates to shared contracts; focused tests and diff gates passed.
Official smoke scripts now support host-dispatched bulk metadata task path checks; parser checks, addon task tests, and Nako server direct-dispatch tests passed.
Workstream closed with final evidence. Live Docker/server smoke remains a documented follow-up because no running server/admin token was owned by this session.

non_goals: new provider count for its own sake

continue_policy.notes: Core target is complete. Future work should open separate lanes for live smoke execution, crate release/versioning, or new official addon families.
